What changed and why

#3 · Diagnostic acceptance

The existing viewer already supplies named anatomical skeletons, mirrored contain-fit transforms, separate current-detection counts/capacity, two model adapters, two association modes, bounded pull streams and explicit ownership/recovery. A fresh audit found a decode-freshness defect: a slow JPEG decode renewed an old image's lifetime.

Freshness now starts at packet receipt, includes decoding, disposes expired bitmaps and guards control/resize redraws. Explicit stale feedback remains recoverable through the next fresh packet. Source and browser clocks stay separate.

#4 · Isolated XYZ experiment

The prior experiment in PR #7 was reverted in PR #9; the available history gives no reason. Reviewed reconstruction code returns under the current pnpm/uv checks rather than restoring the obsolete toolchain. DLT, closest-ray midpoint and bounded reprojection refinement share gates and fixtures.

Strict metadata validates nanosecond times, calibration/image geometry, clocks and identity. Output retains provenance. Per-point refinement prevents a degenerate joint from disabling valid neighbors. Games, capture and canonical wire messages are outside this experiment.

The work is coordinated in one chat with separate subagent ownership for the viewer, geometry and real-service verification. An isolated checkout preserves unrelated camera-default edits in the original workspace.

XYZ: accuracy and coverage together

All results use generated 17-joint observations: 180 frames per scenario, three synthetic people, seed 9158, and 22 scenarios per method. Camera assumptions: ideal 1920 × 1080 images, 1000 px focal length, 1.4 m stand height and 2 m reference baseline. These are illustrative geometry, not tested camera settings.

Nominal 1 px noise. Root is the midpoint of two accepted hips. Errors below are accepted-only p95 in centimeters, shown beside requested root/wrist coverage so abstention cannot hide unusable input.

Host: Windows 11, AMD64, Python 3.12.16, NumPy 2.3.5. Bounded single-thread native pools; fixture generation is excluded. Each workload has 3 trials × 1000 measured batches after 30 warmups per trial. Measurements include validation, reconstruction, allocation and rejection gates for sequential people.

A second Sol reviewer personally exercised the real Python/Vite streams, lifecycle/outage controls and before/after JPEG-delay regression; inspected freshness, XYZ provenance/rejection code and benchmark framing; reviewed the full 408 TypeScript / 196 Python test gate and three-entry production build. A 10/10 score means the declared camera-free software acceptance criteria have no outstanding reviewer deductions after corrections and demonstrated checks. It is an independent engineering assessment of this scope, not proof of hardware accuracy or universal correctness. Reviews were not instructed to inflate scores.

Regression evidence

Baseline viewer: 3 new controlled-clock regressions failed and 39 existing cases passed. The correction covers expired first/replacement bitmaps, fresh recovery, residual decode budget, control redraw and stale/Stop labels. Real browser delay also reproduced accepted old imagery before the fix and zero expired-image draws after it.

Real-service browser acceptance

English at 1440×1050, 390×844 and 320×740, no horizontal overflow. Actual synthetic service transports, no source or HTTP/WebSocket mocks. A 650ms slow-consumer pause skipped 12 superseded observations with zero unsolicited messages. Six independent synthetic epochs. Deliberate service outage has separately recorded expected network errors.

Unexpected page/console errors: 0. Expected deliberate-outage errors are recorded separately. The test starts only its own Python/Vite/browser processes and closes those resources. Generated bodies bypass pose inference; no participant data, camera serials or credentials appear in this report.

Real local-server evidence

English desktop, mobile and narrow layouts use actual served application code and styles. Static appearance is retained; before/after evidence focuses on the stale-image behavior. Any artificial browser decode delay is labeled in the caption.

Remaining limits and physical gates

No physical camera was used or calibrated for this work. Actual joint accuracy, simultaneous USB modes, exposure synchronization, model throughput, participant identity through crossings and externally measured motion-to-visible feedback remain unverified. Synthetic error gates cannot detect every wrong confirmed association or calibration bias. Authoritative depth scoring remains disabled.

The viewer intentionally permits a 0–150 ms presentation-only overlay hold under ADR 0006. It is not a same-exposure guarantee. Host read completion is not verified exposure time; browser arrival age is not exposure age. A lost startup acknowledgment still requires the documented shared-service restart/reload recovery because the protocol cannot safely guess ownership.

The owning XYZ design specifies held-out metric calibration references, exposure offset/drift measurement, static grids and independent dynamic ground truth, one-/three-participant crossings, per-location coverage and external feedback timing. M1 hardware certification remains open in the roadmap. No finite test suite is exhaustive over all devices and real-world motion.
